_provenance: SYNTHETIC test data generated from PulseWorkerV2 comparison/sv2-forecast.js (not production figures)

methodology.protocol: SV2F-1: frozen 2026-11-21 before any outcome was examined. Claims need >= 30 resolved pairs to be reported and n >= 100 with non-overlapping Wilson 95% intervals to be called; observational, not production logic
methodology.v2_signal: Sentiment V2 score as a direction with the PROPOSED convention used for V1 (> 55 UP, < 45 DOWN, else no call); bands 50/50 and 40/60 reported
methodology.v2_analogue: p_up stored in each V2 reading (predictive_json, family_profile_analogues, 24 h only, labelled candidate_unvalidated by its author). With n = 20 analogues its p_up moves in steps of 0.05
methodology.v2_knn: sv2-knn-0.1: k-NN on V2 score, evidence coverage and event intensity (z-scored on the training set), k = clamp(round(sqrt n), 5, 15), inverse-distance weights, Laplace-smoothed p_up; walk-forward: trained only on readings whose outcome was known at the decision time; needs >= 20 such readings
methodology.v1: V1 composite (server_composite_readings, else history) at or before the decision, at most 3 h old, proposed 45/55 direction
methodology.outcome: BTC price (btc_data) at the decision vs the first price at or after decision + horizon (within 6 h); used only once that price exists
methodology.caveats: BTC only (Sentiment V2 covers BTC). Readings about hourly with 12/24 h horizons overlap, so the effective sample is smaller than n. Only the current calc_version is used. CPU bound: the newest 500 readings are scored, each trained on at most the 500 most recent known outcomes
